USM DA Syn 0205 USM Var 24 corn variety
excerpt: USM DA Syn 0205 USM Var 24 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2007 as NSIC 2007 Cn 206. USMARC USM bred it. It takes 101 to 103 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 6.07 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about USM DA Syn 0205 USM Var 24 corn

blocks.caption: Key facts of USM DA Syn 0205 USM Var 24

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

USM DA Syn 0205 USM Var 24 corn takes 101 to 103 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 215 yellow hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 103.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 6.07 t/ha trails the average of its group, 7.17. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 15.2 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 74.08 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
Where and when to plant USM DA Syn 0205 USM Var 24 corn

It is recommended for Luzon in the dry season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).
